Container.Name: Kinder
Container.Overview: Kinder - self-hosted audiogram and podcast video studio. Turns episode audio into captioned vertical clips for social: GPU transcription with Faster-Whisper, automatic clip suggestions, speaker labelling, word-by-word captions, loudness-normalised exports, per-platform upload checks, and RSS automation that cuts clips from new episodes for you to approve. Everything stays on this server.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web interface port

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database and settings. Small, but SQLite dislikes a network share - keep it on fast local storage.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Uploads, rendered clips and scratch space. Renders read and write multi-gigabyte files, so this wants fast local storage rather than the parity-protected array.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Whisper weights. Shared with anything else on this box using a HuggingFace cache - the same weights, downloaded once.

Config.Name: Whisper model
Config.Description: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3 or distil-large-v3. Larger is more accurate and slower.

Config.Name: Sign-up code
Config.Description: Share this with people you want on the box; they use it to create their own account. Leave empty to allow nobody new. Registration is closed without it.

Config.Name: Open sign-ups
Config.Description: Let anybody who reaches the address create an account. Leave false unless this is only on the LAN.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: auto marks the session cookie Secure when the request arrived over HTTPS, which is what a Cloudflare tunnel in front of this provides.

Config.Name: Clip ranking model
Config.Description: Use the bundled language model to rank suggested clips by what they are about. The weights ship inside the image; this costs about 4.4GB of VRAM while loaded.

Config.Name: Model GPU
Config.Description: Which card the language model loads onto. Note llama.cpp and nvidia-smi do not always agree on order - llama.cpp calls the 4090 device 0.

Config.Name: Speaker detection
Config.Description: Run speaker detection automatically after transcription. Off by default: left to estimate how many people are talking it was measurably wrong, and a confident wrong label is worse than none. Ask for it per episode instead.

Config.Name: Watch feeds
Config.Description: Check watched podcast feeds on a schedule. Does nothing until a feed is added, and never publishes anything.

Config.Name: Keep renders for (days)
Config.Description: Delete rendered clips older than this. 0 disables it and nothing is ever removed.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPUs the container can see.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: video is the capability NVENC needs. Omitting it is the usual reason hardware encoding is missing inside a container that otherwise sees the GPU.

Config.Name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
Config.Description: This host has 64 hardware threads and an inference runtime that sizes its pool from the core count will create 64 workers, several of which busy-wait rather than block. The server, the job worker and the models share one process, so a spinning pool starves the loop that answers requests and every click in the browser appears to do nothing.

Config.Name: OMP_WAIT_POLICY
Config.Description: Makes OpenMP worker threads sleep between jobs instead of spinning. Without it the process can sit at several hundred percent CPU with no job running at all.

Config.Name: CT2_INTRA_THREADS
Config.Description: Thread cap for CTranslate2, which is what faster-whisper runs on.

Config.Name: ORT_DISABLE_SPINNING
Config.Description: Stops ONNX Runtime, used for speaker diarization, from busy-waiting between calls.

Config.Name: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS
Config.Description: Thread cap for OpenBLAS.

Config.Name: MKL_NUM_THREADS
Config.Description: Thread cap for MKL.

Config.Name: FREESOUND_API_KEY
Config.Description: Freesound API key for the bulk sound-effects fetcher. Free from https://freesound.org/apiv2/apply/. Optional.

Config.Name: PAS_CONFIG_DIR
Config.Description: Where the app looks for its database.

Config.Name: PAS_DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Where the app writes uploads and renders.

Config.Name: PAS_MODELS_DIR
Config.Description: Where Whisper weights are cached.

Config.Name: PAS_PREFER_GPU
Config.Description: Use the GPU for transcription when one is usable. Falls back to the CPU rather than failing.

Config.Name: PAS_VIDEO_ENCODER
Config.Description: auto probes for NVENC and falls back to libx264.
